scope: Published or county-confirmed fees for county-supplied parcel, address point and road centerline GIS data in Minnesota. A county or layer without a record is not yet confirmed; it is never treated as free.

parcels.note: The county GIS coordinator said the county does not charge for GIS data. The reply covers all county GIS data in one statement, not each layer separately.

address_points.note: The county GIS coordinator said the county does not charge for GIS data. The reply covers all county GIS data in one statement, not each layer separately.

road_centerlines.note: The county GIS coordinator said the county does not charge for GIS data. The reply covers all county GIS data in one statement, not each layer separately.

parcels.amount: $30 Basic Bundle for for-profit use; qualifying nonprofit 10%; qualifying government may receive at no cost
parcels.product: Basic Bundle GIS shapefiles including parcel boundaries and road centerlines, with parcel-related attributes
parcels.note: Published county fee for the listed product. Whether downloading through the county's REST service or another direct route is charged has not been confirmed by the county.

road_centerlines.amount: $30 Basic Bundle for for-profit use; qualifying nonprofit 10%; qualifying government may receive at no cost
road_centerlines.product: Basic Bundle GIS shapefiles (road centerlines are bundled with parcel boundaries; one bundle price)
road_centerlines.note: Road centerlines are part of the same published Basic Bundle as parcels; the amount is the bundle price, not a separate centerline fee. Whether REST/direct download is charged has not been confirmed by the county.

parcels.amount: $697 complete dataset; partial $0.04 per parcel ($20 minimum) plus service fee; professional service $75/hour (half-hour minimum)
parcels.product: Parcel shapefile through a signed data request and disclosure
parcels.note: The county GIS office said on 2026-10-23 that its parcel REST service is no longer public or authoritative and is not covered by the fee schedule; parcel data is available only by signed request, with time billed case by case. Amounts are from the IT section of the 2025-effective fee schedule and are being confirmed with the county.

road_centerlines.note: Published in the IT section of the county's 2025-effective fee schedule: shapefile delivery with a signed data disclosure. Whether REST or direct download is available for this layer has not been confirmed; the county said parcel data comes only by request. Figures are being confirmed with the county.

address_points.product: Rural address points shapefile; city addresses not included (signed data disclosure)
address_points.note: Published in the IT section of the county's 2025-effective fee schedule: shapefile delivery with a signed data disclosure. Whether REST or direct download is available for this layer has not been confirmed; the county said parcel data comes only by request. Figures are being confirmed with the county.

parcels.note: The county IT office answered the parcel, address point and road centerline REST download question with no fees for these services, and said no license or attribution terms apply. The county noted there is no official uptime guarantee.
